payload.justification: The door is locked and unlocking requires carrying a matching item. The box is the only other visible object and may contain one.
payload.expected_outcome: Details about the box's contents or whether it can be opened.
payload.subgoal: Find an item that can unlock the door.
plan: Look at the box to check its contents or state.
If the box holds a usable item, carry it.
Try to unlock the door with the matching item.
